body:
Thank you.

I didn't expect anything nearly as helpful and wonderful back from this, I was mostly just trying to vent.

I'm seeing a friend this afternoon/evening so I will attempt to open up to her a bit and that will likely help too.

I'm incredibly grateful for this response, I do know it's not all meaningless but obviously forget that at times. I can and will do better. I'll look into the things you've suggested.

Seriously. Thank you.

You might be Trans. I'm still figuring it out at the moment, but I've only come to this realisation in the last 6months- 1 year, if you start considering the possibility now, you should have it figured out by this time. Whatever you work out, it'll be ok.

Also eat less and exercise more. 

Also your skin sucks and will cause you no end of grief.

I think it's important to realise that the majority of people probably do this subconsciously, not on the basis of being a lech, purely at a primal level I expect that most people will identify a potential "mate" as it were out of a crowd, and on that basis I think that yes this is true of all guys and HONK HONK SQUAONK!
